<script>
(function () {
  var C = window.ADK_BANNER || {};
  var bar = document.getElementById('adk-banner');
  if (!bar) return;

  var KEY = 'adk_banner_dismissed';

  /* Si le visiteur a fermé le bandeau récemment, on ne l'affiche pas. */
  try {
    var until = window.localStorage.getItem(KEY);
    if (until && Date.now() < parseInt(until, 10)) { bar.remove(); return; }
  } catch (e) { /* navigation privée : on affiche quand même */ }

  var end = new Date(C.endDate).getTime();
  if (isNaN(end)) { end = Date.now() + 7 * 864e5; }

  if (Date.now() >= end && C.onExpire === 'hide') { bar.remove(); return; }

  document.getElementById('adk-banner-msg').textContent = C.message || '';
  document.getElementById('adk-banner-timer-label').textContent = C.countdownLabel || '';

  var cta = document.getElementById('adk-banner-cta');
  cta.href = C.ctaUrl || '#';
  cta.firstElementChild.textContent = C.ctaLabel || '';

  var out = {
    d: bar.querySelector('[data-adk="d"]'),
    h: bar.querySelector('[data-adk="h"]'),
    m: bar.querySelector('[data-adk="m"]'),
    s: bar.querySelector('[data-adk="s"]')
  };
  function pad(n) { return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n; }

  var tick = setInterval(update, 1000);

  function update() {
    var left = end - Date.now();

    if (left <= 0) {
      clearInterval(tick);
      if (C.onExpire === 'hide') {
        if (typeof restore === 'function') { restore(); }
        bar.remove();
        return;
      }
      document.getElementById('adk-banner-msg').textContent = C.onExpire;
      if (typeof layout === 'function') { setTimeout(layout, 0); }
      document.getElementById('adk-banner-timer').remove();
      return;
    }
    var s = Math.floor(left / 1000);
    out.d.textContent = pad(Math.floor(s / 86400));
    out.h.textContent = pad(Math.floor(s / 3600) % 24);
    out.m.textContent = pad(Math.floor(s / 60) % 60);
    out.s.textContent = pad(s % 60);
  }

  update();
  bar.hidden = false;

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------
     Place la page sous le bandeau : on décale le contenu vers le bas
     et, si le menu du site est collé en haut, on le descend aussi.
     --------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var bodyPad = document.body.style.paddingTop;
  var moved = [];

  function layout() {
    var h = bar.offsetHeight;
    document.body.style.paddingTop = h + 'px';

    moved.forEach(function (m) { m.el.style.top = m.top; });
    moved = [];

    var tops = document.querySelectorAll('header, nav, [class*="header"], [id*="header"], [class*="sticky"], [class*="fixed"]');
    for (var i = 0; i < tops.length; i++) {
      var el = tops[i];
      if (el === bar || bar.contains(el)) continue;
      var cs = window.getComputedStyle(el);
      if ((cs.position === 'fixed' || cs.position === 'sticky') && parseFloat(cs.top || '0') < 1) {
        moved.push({ el: el, top: el.style.top });
        el.style.top = h + 'px';
      }
    }
  }

  layout();
  window.addEventListener('resize', layout);
  window.addEventListener('load', layout);

  function restore() {
    document.body.style.paddingTop = bodyPad || '';
    (moved || []).forEach(function (m) { m.el.style.top = m.top; });
    window.removeEventListener('resize', layout);
    window.removeEventListener('load', layout);
  }

  document.getElementById('adk-banner-close').addEventListener('click', function () {
    clearInterval(tick);
    try {
      var days = typeof C.dismissDays === 'number' ? C.dismissDays : 7;
      window.localStorage.setItem(KEY, String(Date.now() + days * 864e5));
    } catch (e) {}
    restore();
    bar.remove();
  });
})();
</script>
